description: This grouped vertical bar chart illustrates the Shapley value across a sequence of positional categories for three different models. The horizontal axis contains the categories, ordered sequentially from left to right as L4+, L3, L2, L1, T, R1, R2, R3, and R4+. The vertical axis represents the "Shapley value" on a linear scale, ranging from slightly below 0 to 80, with numeric tick labels at intervals of 20 and corresponding horizontal gridlines. Within each category, up to three bars are grouped together side-by-side, representing different models as indicated by a legend in the top right corner: mBERT (light blue), XLM-R (dark blue), and chLSTM (light green). All bars feature a thin black outline. The values vary significantly across the categories, with the tallest bars located in category T, where mBERT is approximately 59, XLM-R is approximately 54, and chLSTM reaches the maximum chart value of approximately 79. The shortest bars are found in the L3, R2, R3, and R4+ categories, where values hover near zero; notably, the chLSTM bars in categories R2, R3, and R4+ extend slightly below the zero line to approximately -1. The categories are arranged in a specific positional sequence centered around T, rather than being sorted by value, and no specific bars are visually emphasized beyond their standard color coding and outlines.
